text:
Claire: Hey team — blocking issue for a CI job that uses a delegated service token. After the recent SSO attribute mapping change, switching org in the console for the service account now returns a 403. Started ~10:30am UTC. Repro steps below.

Claire: Repro steps: 1) Use delegated token from CI (service account) 2) call GET /v1/orgs/:org_id/projects 3) see 403 Permission denied. Works before SSO change.

Claire: curl output: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/projects
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"permission_denied","message":"service account cannot act on behalf of user"}```

Rajat: :eyes: can you paste the token scopes (just the claim list, masked) and the service account role?

Claire: Token claims (masked): `{sub: svc-12345, scopes: [read:projects, on_behalf_of], iss: idp.redwoodcorp}` — but after SSO change the claim now shows `scopes: [read:projects]` (on_behalf_of dropped). Service account has role `project:editor` on target project.

Maya: That matches my suspicion — IdP attribute/claim mapping removed the delegation/on_behalf_of scope for delegated tokens. When the claim is missing the token can't be used for "act_as" flows and we return 403. Did the IdP change remove any group-to-scope mappings?

Claire: Confirmed with IdP team — they renamed an attribute and our SSO mapping rule that used to populate `on_behalf_of` stopped matching.

eng-oncall: Quick checks: 1) run `redwoodctl iam bindings get --project <proj>` to confirm binding for svc-12345 2) introspect token at `/oauth2/introspect` to see claims. If scope missing, need to reissue or update mapping.

Claire: Ran introspect: `{active: true, scope: "read:projects"}`. Bindings show svc-12345 has project/editor.

Maya: Options: A) Update IdP mapping to include `on_behalf_of` again (preferred) B) Temporarily issue a non-delegated machine token as a workaround (if CI can use service-token scoped to project). C) Grant the service account a higher privileged role (not ideal).

support-bot: Created ticket REDWOOD-INC-10234 and assigned to infra-auth. Priority: P1 since CI deployments are failing.

Rajat: For correlation, can you paste last 6 chars of the token you used (masked) and the request id from the 403 response?

Claire: Masked suffix: `...a9f3b2`. Request-id from 403 header: `req_2026-03-17_g7h3k`.

eng-oncall: Thanks — forwarding to infra-auth. Short-term workaround: generate a project-scoped service token from Console > Service Accounts > Tokens and swap CI to use that token; that avoids delegation claim.

Claire: I'll try the project-scoped token and also coordinate with IdP to restore the mapping. Thanks. :thumbsup:

Maya: After IdP change is fixed please confirm by running the introspect and showing `scope: [read:projects, on_behalf_of]`. Also we should add a rollout checklist item to validate claim mappings on SSO changes.

Claire: Will do. If infra-auth needs anything else ping me in thread.

support-bot: Ticket REDWOOD-INC-10234 updated: infra-auth acknowledged, ETA 2h.
